facts.fact: The evaluation says Basse Area Council will embark on a Digital Tax Collection System (e-payment) for council revenue; no council is stated as live on it, and the report gives no count of councils recording.

The evaluation of the 2021-2025 PFM strategy reports DTCS implementation, e-payment sensitisation and valuation systems largely unimplemented in Banjul City Council, and linking DTCS to IFMIS and e-payment incomplete in KMC and Janjangbureh; digitalisation is called the weakest reform area (report dated April 2026, period to 2025).
The Pillar 6 revenue reform plan says most of the funding will come from local government authorities with support from donors; no separate budget line for DTCS is stated.

systems.tiers: KMC, Janjangbureh, Banjul City Council, Basse Area Council named; IFMIS link incomplete
